questions.prompt: What does Gemini CLI call the hook event that runs before a tool call?

options.explanation: That is the name in Claude Code and Codex. Gemini CLI uses its own name.
Right. Gemini CLI uses BeforeTool and AfterTool.
Notification is for alerts, not the moment before a tool call.

questions.prompt: Which exit code from a hook blocks a tool call in Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI?

options.explanation: Exit 0 is success. In Claude Code it does not even approve a PreToolUse call.
Other codes don't block on their own. They show an error or a warning.
Right. In all three, exit 2 blocks a tool call, with the reason written to stderr.

questions.prompt: A formatting hook runs after an edit. Why put a guard before the tool call instead?

options.text: A post-tool hook can't undo what already ran
options.explanation: Right. Anthropic and OpenAI both say PostToolUse can't undo a tool that already ran.

options.text: A post-tool hook can't read the tool input
options.explanation: PostToolUse gets the tool input. The problem is timing: the action has already happened.

options.text: A post-tool hook can't run a shell script
options.explanation: Post-tool hooks run commands too, like Anthropic's Prettier recipe.
